raw_response:
Very strong balance sheet metrics support a high-grade rating: liabilities are only about 40% of assets, equity is nearly 60% of assets, and retained earnings are exceptionally large relative to the balance sheet. Liquidity is adequate rather than exceptional (current ratio 1.28), so the profile looks stronger than typical single-A or low-AA issuers but not clearly at the absolute AAA level on the figures alone.

DECISION: AA+
